$comment: The owner-supplied films and where each belongs on the public website. A film is built into the published site ONLY when rights.website.status is VERIFIED (the owner's rule: only VERIFIED assets authorized for the channel enter an externally distributed build). `node apps/website/build.mjs --films=preview` builds every film for a local or staging review, with a banner on every page; that build is not for publication. Renditions are produced by scripts/media/prepare-web-films.mjs into apps/website/media/ (git-ignored until a film is cleared). Rights evidence lives in the media-rights ledger; see docs/media/WEBSITE_FILM_PLACEMENT.md.
